summary: Legacy recovery-only dependency-chain operation; public writes use ascet_edit.create_dependent_chain with intent=apply

args.name: request-file
args.description: Legacy recovery JSON request containing intent, optional expected target-state snapshot/editability authorization, and complete Provider, Consumer Imported, Local, and Dependency definitions; public writes use ascet_edit.create_dependent_chain with intent=apply

args.name: --json
args.description: Emit the protocolVersion=1 JSON response envelope

preconditions: ASCET ToolAPI session must be available.
Live ASCET access must run through the serial executor.
The request must contain exact Provider and Consumer component paths.
Apply must compare the approved target-specific semantic state and perform mandatory readback.

examples.description: Legacy recovery invocation; not the public model-facing dependency-chain write path

pitfalls: This operation uses compensating rollback rather than a database-native transaction.
Do not retry after mutationStarted=true without first reading the live state.
